features.title: One Host port for Sessions that live on another runtime
features.summary: A registry the Session controller provides and remote sources register into; ownership is claimed from list answers and re-checked through owns() only when a Session id is not cached.
failureModes: A cached claim of a source that is no longer registered is dropped before asking the remaining sources.
An id no source owns resolves to nothing, so the controller keeps it local.

verification.testName: claims follow a source and are forgotten with it
resolveOwner asks each source only when nothing is claimed
a cached claim of an unregistered source is dropped before asking
an id no source owns resolves to nothing

telemetry.reason: An in-memory registry of remote session sources; lookups are synchronous map reads with no I/O to time.
